rows.label: TIPS_ADV_ELEONORA
rows.name: Eleonora's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_LIN
rows.name: Lin's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_LAO
rows.name: Lao's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_TATSU
rows.name: Tatsu's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_VANDHAM
rows.name: Vandham's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_L
rows.name: Lu's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_DOUG
rows.name: Doug's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_001_01_TITLE
rows.name: Head to the "!" Marker

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_001_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
If you're unsure what to do, first head to [ST:col p1=red ]a place marked with a "!"[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
The way forward will open up on its own.
But taking a few detours can enrich your life.
Most importantly, don't take things too rigidly.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_002_01_TITLE
rows.name: Target and Draw Your Weapon

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_002_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=red ]Target[ST:col p1=lightblue ] an enemy and [ST:col p1=red ]draw your weapon[ST:col p1=lightblue ] to begin battle.
That's all you need to remember for now.
It's all right, don't worry.
I'll back you up, so feel free to try things out.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_002_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Target:
[ST:icon p1=r ]

Draw Weapon:
[ST:icon p1=a ] while targeting

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_003_01_TITLE
rows.name: Sprinting

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_003_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
There's still some distance to the Habitat.
At a leisurely stroll, it'll be dark before we get there.
When you're in a hurry, [ST:col p1=red ]sprint[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Just don't let running away be the only thing you're fast at, okay?

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_003_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Toggle Sprint:
[ST:icon p1=analp ]

Auto-run:
[ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=b ]

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_004_01_TITLE
rows.name: Segment Feature Unlocked

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_004_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
My name is Eleonora, and I handle general BLADE support.
I'm pleased to tell you that the [ST:col p1=red ]map[ST:col p1=lightblue ]'s [ST:col p1=red ]Segments[ST:col p1=lightblue ] feature is now available.
It displays information about planet Mira on your screen.
Please use it to check your location and destination!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_004_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Check Segment:
Main Menu > Map > Segments

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_005_01_TITLE
rows.name: Gear and Arts

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_005_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Overeds are no ordinary opponents.
I recommend checking your weapon and armor [ST:col p1=red ]gear[ST:col p1=lightblue ] again!
Oh, and don't forget to prepare your Arts!
[ST:col p1=red ]Leveling up your Arts[ST:col p1=lightblue ] is the first step to improving your combat strength!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_005_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Check Gear/Level Up Arts:
Main Menu > Characters >
Inner Gear/Arts Setup

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_006_01_TITLE
rows.name: Installing Data Probes

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_006_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
I'm Lao from the Pathfinders. Let's save the introductions for when we meet.
For now, here's some advice on expanding FrontierNET.
From now on, to install a data probe, [ST:col p1=red ]approach an FN Spot[ST:col p1=lightblue ] and press [ST:icon p1=a ].
I recommend installing probes whenever you find an FN Spot.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_007_01_TITLE
rows.name: Fighting Giant Enemies

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_007_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Just report back to complete the mission. But before that, let me tell you something.
Normally, you'll need the power of a [ST:col p1=red ]Doll[ST:col p1=lightblue ] to fight huge enemies like Vasalts.
Defeating an Overed without a Doll is nothing short of a miracle.
Some BLADEs make up for that with ingenuity and effort, but don't push your luck.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_008_01_TITLE
rows.name: Using BLADE Facilities

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_008_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Congratulations on joining BLADE!
As a BLADE, you're now authorized to use various facilities.
You can use the [ST:col p1=red ]shops[ST:col p1=lightblue ], [ST:col p1=red ]Arms Manufacturers[ST:col p1=lightblue ], and [ST:col p1=red ]Quest Board[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
I'll let you know about the other facilities when they become available.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_009_01_TITLE
rows.name: Skip Travel

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_009_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Ever wish you could get right back to somewhere you've already visited?
That's when you should use [ST:col p1=red ]Skip Travel[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
You can instantly return to FN Spots with installed data probes or to landmarks.
It makes reporting back in NLA easy, too. You can use it from the map!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_010_01_TITLE
rows.name: Supporting Arms Manufacturers

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_010_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=red ]Arms Manufacturers[ST:col p1=lightblue ] support BLADE behind the scenes by developing weapons.
And we can support them in return.
Please access the [ST:col p1=red ]AM Terminal[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Depending on the support you give them, they may develop new products!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_011_01_TITLE
rows.name: Tatsu's Navigation Ball

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_011_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
When using the [ST:col p1=red ]Navigation Ball[ST:col p1=lightblue ], you have to select the quest to track, mo!
Even this super-convenient item is just junk if you don't select a quest, mo!
The ball might lose its way from time to time, mo...
A big-hearted Hom Hom will forgive it even then, mo!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_011_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Set Navigation:
Main Menu > Quests >
select a quest, then press [ST:icon p1=y ]

Deploy Navigation Ball: [ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=x ]

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_012_01_TITLE
rows.name: Advancing Story Quests

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_012_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Your BLADE duties are finally starting in earnest!
You can accept [ST:col p1=red ]Story Quests at the BLADE Home to advance the story[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Just watch out for requirements like level and survey rate.
Let's do our best together to find the Lifepoint!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_013_01_TITLE
rows.name: Using BLADE Scout

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_013_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Good work completing your mission! A new feature is now available!
Through [ST:col p1=red ]BLADE Scout[ST:col p1=lightblue ], you can temporarily enlist help from BLADE members on other teams.
Use it from the [ST:col p1=red ]BLADE Scout Console[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
That means all BLADE facilities are now available to you!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_014_01_TITLE
rows.name: Editing Your Profile

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_014_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Oh! Lastly, please tell me about your [ST:col p1=red ]profile[ST:col p1=lightblue ]!
It's important for introducing you to other BLADEs.
Please edit it from the status screen!
I-it's certainly not because I'm personally curious or anything... Yes!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_014_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Editing Your Profile:
Main Menu > Characters > Status > [ST:icon p1=x ]

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_015_01_TITLE
rows.name: Class Changes and Skills

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_015_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
You're starting to look like a proper BLADE!
If your class rank is 10, it's time to consider [ST:col p1=red ]changing classes[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Once you move up from Drifter, you can also use [ST:col p1=red ]Skills[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
You can change classes anytime. Well, give it a try and see for yourself.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_015_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Change Class:
Main Menu > Characters >
Change Class

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_016_01_TITLE
rows.name: Battle Members

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_016_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
As a BLADE, you've gained a great deal of freedom alongside your responsibilities.
Some special missions prevent certain members from participating,
but you're generally free to choose [ST:col p1=red ]who to take into battle[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Of course, don't hesitate to invite Lin or me along.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_016_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Organize Party:
Main Menu > Change Party Members
or
Speak to potential members in NLA

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_017_01_TITLE
rows.name: Making the Most of FrontierNET

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_017_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Making good use of FrontierNET?
FN Spots with installed data probes produce [ST:col p1=red ]Miranium[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Depending on the location, you may occasionally obtain [ST:col p1=red ]Rare Resources[ST:col p1=lightblue ], too.
Choosing which probes to install where is a chance to show your skill as a BLADE.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_018_01_TITLE
rows.name: Pocket Money from Lin

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_018_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
The material "Succulent Meat," the rare resource "Arc Sand Ore,"
and a little Miranium, just between us.
Try using them to [ST:col p1=red ]support Arms Manufacturers[ST:col p1=lightblue ] or [ST:col p1=red ]request the creation of Augments[ST:col p1=lightblue ]!
But this is your only pocket money! You'll have to get them yourself from now on, okay?

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_019_01_TITLE
rows.name: Filling in the Collepedia

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_019_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Let me tell you about the [ST:col p1=red ]Collepedia[ST:col p1=lightblue ]!
It's a system for cataloging unknown items discovered on Planet Mira.
We ask BLADEs traveling to different locations to register them.
We've prepared [ST:col p1=red ]a little reward[ST:col p1=lightblue ] for your cooperation, so please help us out!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_019_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Collepedia:
Main Menu > Lists > Collepedia

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_021_01_TITLE
rows.name: Complete Segment Recon

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_021_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Is your survey of Planet Mira going well?
Installing data probes isn't the only way to raise your [ST:col p1=red ]survey rate[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Completing [ST:col p1=red ]Segment Recon[ST:col p1=lightblue ] around FN Spots also raises it.
Consider completing recon in nearby locations, too.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_022_01_TITLE
rows.name: Founding MEREDES & Co.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_022_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
It seems a new Arms Manufacturer has been founded!
They're apparently introducing new technology based on data collected from battles with aliens.
The company is called "[ST:col p1=red ]MEREDES & Co.[ST:col p1=lightblue ]".
Please check it out at the AM Terminal.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_023_01_TITLE
rows.name: Customizing the BLADE Home

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_023_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
It's amazing that the Ma-non moved their entire spaceship here, home and all!
Let's make our own BLADE Home a lovely place by [ST:col p1=red ]customizing[ST:col p1=lightblue ] it, too.
You can select wall colors and decals from the console.
More decals become available when you meet certain requirements!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_024_01_TITLE
rows.name: Founding Candid & Credible

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_024_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Come to think of it, the Ma-non are also starting an Arms Manufacturer.
I bet they have technology beyond anything we humans could imagine...
The company is called "[ST:col p1=red ]Candid & Credible[ST:col p1=lightblue ]".
Please check it out at the AM Terminal.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_025_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock Unlocked

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_025_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
A new combat technique humanity acquired along with our B.B. bodies...
That's [ST:col p1=red ]Overclock[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
It's a powerful technique you can only use when you have at least 3,000 TP.
While active, [ST:col p1=red ]Art cooldowns are drastically shortened[ST:col p1=lightblue ].

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_026_01_TITLE
rows.name: Getting a Doll License

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_026_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
I've heard about you.
Word is you're doing quite well as a BLADE...
So, what do you say? Isn't it about time you got yourself a Doll?
If you're interested in getting a [ST:col p1=red ]Doll License[ST:col p1=lightblue ], come see me. I'll be waiting.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_027_01_TITLE
rows.name: Flight Pack Project

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_027_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
We're finally starting practical tests of flight-capable Dolls.
We're looking for people confident in their brains and skills.
To participate, go to the [ST:col p1=red ]Quest Board[ST:col p1=lightblue ] and accept "[ST:col p1=red ]Flight Module[ST:col p1=lightblue ]".
Let's give our Dolls wings!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_028_01_TITLE
rows.name: Alongside the Real Elma

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_028_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
I won't ask what you thought when you saw my appearance, at least not now.
If you'd like to continue adventuring with me in my true form...
Yes, I'll grant your wish.
Shall we continue our adventure? This planet is still full of mysteries.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_028_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Change Elma's Appearance:
Main Menu > System > Settings >
Visual

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_029_01_TITLE
rows.name: Planet Mira Survey Complete!!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_029_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Uncovering everything on Planet Mira is an extraordinary achievement.
Perhaps the day I rescued you from that escape pod
was a turning point for humanity.
You have my heartfelt gratitude. Thank you so much.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_030_01_TITLE
rows.name: Lu's Shop Now Open!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_030_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Well, hello there! Welcome to Lu's shop!
Our service is adding [ST:col p1=red ]slots[ST:col p1=lightblue ] to your equipment.
We take payment in [ST:col p1=red ]Miranium[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Now, let's strengthen your equipment and snatch victory from sudden death!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_031_01_TITLE
rows.name: Founding Factory 1.21

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_031_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
The doctor is apparently starting an Arms Manufacturer!
I hear the doctor is the only employee, though... Will that be all right?
The company is called "[ST:col p1=red ]Factory 1.21[ST:col p1=lightblue ]".
Please check it out at the AM Terminal.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_032_01_TITLE
rows.name: Founding the Nopon Commerce Guild

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_032_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
A Nopon Arms Manufacturer is establishing a branch office in NLA!
I'm really curious about what products they'll carry.
It's called the "[ST:col p1=red ]Nopon Commerce Guild[ST:col p1=lightblue ]". A very straightforward name.
Please check it out at the AM Terminal.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_033_01_TITLE
rows.name: Founding Six Stars

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_033_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
A Larsian Arms Manufacturer is expanding into NLA!
Their goods must be manly, samurai-like, and maidenly! Probably...
The company is called "[ST:col p1=red ]Six Stars[ST:col p1=lightblue ]". Apparently it's read as Mutsuraboshi?
Please check it out at the AM Terminal.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_034_01_TITLE
rows.name: Vandham's Thoughtful Gesture

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_034_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
The Flight Pack Project is safely complete. Good work.
I've refitted your Dolls with [ST:col p1=red ]Flight Modules[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
You see, this project was a dream of mine, too.
Consider it a personal thank-you for making that dream come true. Thanks.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_035_01_TITLE
rows.name: Founding Orphe Parfait

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_035_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
It looks like the Orpheans are establishing an Arms Manufacturer, too!
As an engineer myself, I'm interested in the Growth's technology.
The company is called "[ST:col p1=red ]Orphe Parfait[ST:col p1=lightblue ]". That's rather cute, isn't it?
Please check it out at the AM Terminal.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_036_01_TITLE
rows.name: Registering Pilots

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_036_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Congratulations, you're now a Doll pilot.
Before you can take the controls, you'll need to learn how to [ST:col p1=red ]register pilots[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Once registered, the Doll will be deployed to the [ST:col p1=red ]Doll Garage[ST:col p1=lightblue ] at the BLADE Home Console.
Don't forget whenever you get a new machine!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_036_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Register Pilot:
BLADE Home Console >
Doll Garage > select Doll >
Register Pilot

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_037_01_TITLE
rows.name: Gameplay Tips

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_037_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
You've only just woken up, so there must still be a lot you don't know.
Whenever that happens, check the [ST:col p1=red ]Gameplay Tips[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
You're sure to find information that will help you right now.
Make good use of them as a guide to surviving on Mira.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_037_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Check Tips:
Main Menu > System > Gameplay Tips

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_038_01_TITLE
rows.name: Damage Trial Unlocked

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_038_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
The BLADE Home Console has a simulator
for testing your combat abilities,
called the [ST:col p1=red ]Damage Trial[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Put it to good use, and it should help improve your combat skills.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_039_01_TITLE
rows.name: Xenoform Immigration

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_039_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Completing certain missions will bring alien residents to NLA.
In some cases, they may even
[ST:col p1=red ]start a new Arms Manufacturer[ST:col p1=lightblue ]!
NLA will develop even further if humans and aliens work together!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_040_01_TITLE
rows.name: Getting a More Powerful Doll

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_040_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
If you support Sakuraba Industries until its company level is maxed out,
Dolls of [ST:col p1=red ]frame level 50[ST:col p1=lightblue ] will be added to the shop.
Remember, though, that your Inner Level must also be at least [ST:col p1=red ]50[ST:col p1=lightblue ] to pilot them.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_050_01_TITLE
rows.name: Intro to Squads (Online Play)

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_050_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=red ]Squads[ST:col p1=lightblue ] let you [ST:col p1=red ]connect with up to 32 BLADE members[ST:col p1=lightblue ]!
You can take on shared missions together,
scout other BLADE members to assist you, and more...
Making good use of squads is sure to broaden your mission opportunities!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_050_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
An active membership to online services
is required to play online with others.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_051_01_TITLE
rows.name: Quick Cooldown Unlocked

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_051_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Before you fight the aliens, I want to tell you about a new combat technique.
It's called [ST:col p1=red ]Quick Cooldown[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
By sending stored Aux Energy to your Inner Weapon, you can
[ST:col p1=red ]instantly recharge an Art on cooldown[ST:col p1=lightblue ] and use it again.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_051_02_CONTENT
rows.name:
Quick Cooldown:
[ST:icon p1=y ] while selecting Art on cooldown

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_052_01_TITLE
rows.name: Aux Energy Capacity

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_052_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
The amount of Aux Energy available for Quick Cooldown
increases as you acquire [ST:col p1=red ]Energy Storage Units[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
As your survey of planet Mira progresses, you'll receive these units
as a [ST:col p1=red ]reward based on your survey rate[ST:col p1=lightblue ]. For now, just keep at it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_001_01_TITLE
rows.name: Navigation Panel

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_001_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Press [ST:icon p1=anarp ] to display the navigation panel in the bottom right of
the screen. This will show the objectives of your currently tracked
quest, etc. Track quests from Main Menu > Quests.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_001_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can press [ST:icon p1=crslr ] to toggle the navigation panel's category.
(Categories are unlocked as you advance the main story.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_002_01_TITLE
rows.name: Mini-map

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_002_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
The mini-map is displayed in the top-right corner of the screen
and charts your character's immediate surroundings.
You can change the map's zoom level by pressing [ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=crsd ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_002_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Icons will be shown on your mini-map to indicate your character's
current location, the destination of your tracked quest, and more.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_002_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
If you see a circular area marker around the destination icon,
it means that your objective is located somewhere within that area.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_003_01_TITLE
rows.name: Control Guide

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_003_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can check the controls for this game at any time by
going to Main Menu > System > Control Guide.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_004_01_TITLE
rows.name: Stats

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_004_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can check the status of your current active party members
by going to Main Menu > Characters > Status.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_005_01_TITLE
rows.name: Potential

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_005_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Potential is one of the stats by which your characters are measured.
The higher its value, the more HP the character will regain from Soul Voices
and Arts, and the more damage they will deal with Tension Arts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_005_01_PAGE02
rows.name: It also increases the damage effect when activating Overclock on foot.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_006_01_TITLE
rows.name: Buffs

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_006_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Buffs can temporarily strengthen your party members,
for example by boosting their stats. Buff effects will be
canceled out if an opposite debuff is applied.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_006_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
The higher an effect's level (from I to VI), the stronger it is.
Stacking multiple buffs with the same effect at the same level
has a chance to raise the level.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_006_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
In addition to being applied by Arts, buffs can also be the
result of weather effects.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_007_01_TITLE
rows.name: Debuffs

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_007_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Debuffs are status effects that can temporarily weaken afflicted
characters. They dissipate with time, or can be removed by using
the correct healing Art or by applying the opposite buff.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_007_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
There are two categories of debuff effects.
Reactions: debuff effects that affect actions.
Debuffs: effects such as reduced stats.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_007_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
The higher an effect's level (from I to VI), the stronger it is.
Stacking multiple debuffs with the same effect at the same level
has a chance to raise the level.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_007_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
In addition to being applied by Arts, debuffs can also be the
result of weather effects.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_008_01_TITLE
rows.name: Debuff Resistance

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_008_01_PAGE01
rows.name: Debuffs may fail to affect enemies with resistance to them.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_008_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
When a debuff fails, one of the following messages appears.
Resistant: The target has some resistance and has resisted the effect.
Immune: The target has complete resistance and has nullified the effect.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_009_01_TITLE
rows.name: Inner Gear

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_009_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Under Main Menu > Characters > Inner Gear,
you can change your active party's equipment,
including Inner Weapons and Inner Armor.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_009_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Each equipment item has a required Inner Level.
Raise your Inner Level to equip more powerful gear.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_009_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Additionally, if a piece of equipment has empty slots for additional effects,
you can press [ST:icon p1=zl ] to jump to the additional effects section of the menu and
select an empty slot to attach or detach augments to and from it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_010_01_TITLE
rows.name: Inner Weapons

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_010_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Inner Weapons are the weapons used by characters.
Each character can equip one melee weapon and one ranged weapon.
The weapons available depend on their class.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_011_01_TITLE
rows.name: Inner Armor

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_011_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Armor is your main means of protection when on foot.
There are five slots you can equip armor in, although
certain pieces will occupy more than a single slot.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_012_01_TITLE
rows.name: Toggling Headgear On and Off

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_012_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can toggle whether you want your ground gear
headgear to be visible in Main Menu > System > Settings > Visual.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_013_01_TITLE
rows.name: Auto-saving

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_013_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
This game includes an auto-save feature.
Do not turn off your Nintendo Switch system while
the "Auto-saving..." message is displayed.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_013_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
The save data created by the auto-save feature is available
when selecting Load Game on the title screen.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_014_01_TITLE
rows.name: Play Awards

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_014_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Play Awards can be thought of as medals which you are awarded for
meeting certain conditions while playing the game. You can check them
from Main Menu > Lists > Play Awards.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_015_01_TITLE
rows.name: Auto-attacking

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_015_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Once you draw your weapon with [ST:icon p1=a ], your character automatically attacks at regular intervals.
This is called auto-attacking.
Auto-attacks will not occur if the enemy is outside your weapon's range.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_016_01_TITLE
rows.name: Arts

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_016_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Arts are special abilities your weapons give you access to.
Select them with [ST:icon p1=crslr ], then press [ST:icon p1=a ] to use one.
You can set a maximum of eight to your Arts Palette.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_016_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
After you use an Art, it will be put on cooldown, taking time
until you can use it again. Different Arts have cooldowns of
different length.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_017_01_TITLE
rows.name: Restoring HP in Battle

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_017_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You have a few ways to restore HP in battle: Successfully
reacting to Soul Voice prompts, hitting Soul Challenges
accurately, using healing Arts, or using battle items.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_018_01_TITLE
rows.name: Soul Voices

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_018_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Soul Voices are exchanges of calls with your allies during battle.
Successfully answering a Soul Voice
triggers various effects that give you an advantage in battle.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_018_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
When an ally issues a Soul Voice prompt, Arts on your palette
which match the prompt's color will be highlighted.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_018_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Using a highlighted Art successfully answers the Soul Voice.
Both you and the ally who called out recover HP, and the corresponding effects are applied.
Your bond with that ally also deepens.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_019_01_TITLE
rows.name: Soul Challenges

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_019_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Under certain circumstances, an orange circle may appear
in the center of the screen while you're engaging in battle.
This is called a Soul Challenge.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_019_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Press [ST:icon p1=b ] with the correct timing to succeed in the challenge
and issue a Soul Voice from the controlled character, restoring
some of the party's HP, raising the Soul Stage by one, and more.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_019_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
If you press [ST:icon p1=b ] at exactly the right moment, you'll see
a "Perfect" notification pop up, which will additionally
restore some TP.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_020_01_TITLE
rows.name: Soul Stage

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_020_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
This gauge rises in stages when you succeed at Soul Challenges.
Each stage increases the frequency of Soul Voices and the TP
gained from Perfect Soul Challenges.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_020_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
On the other hand, be aware that as your Soul Stage increases,
the Soul Challenges will also get more difficult to hit perfectly.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_021_01_TITLE
rows.name: Battle Positioning

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_021_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Attacks delivered from behind an enemy, or from higher or
lower ground, have increased accuracy and critical chance.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_022_01_TITLE
rows.name: Drop Results (Battle Spoils)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_022_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Defeating enemies may yield treasure chests containing loot.
These can contain Materials from enemies, equipment, and other items.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_022_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Treasure chests have increasing levels of rarity:
bronze < silver < gold.
The rarer the chest, the more valuable the items you can obtain.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_023_01_TITLE
rows.name: Materials

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_023_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Materials are objects originating from enemies. You can obtain
them as rewards for defeating enemies, and use them to
develop or strengthen equipment, or to complete quests.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_024_01_TITLE
rows.name: Enemies

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_024_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Planet Mira is home to various enemies, including its native wildlife.
Different enemies have different strengths and behaviors.
The colors of their names and levels change according to the threat posed by their level relative to yours.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_024_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Colors in order of increasing danger:
Blue (weaker) < white (equal) < yellow (stronger) < red (dangerous) < purple (extremely dangerous)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_025_01_TITLE
rows.name: Locations

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_025_01_PAGE01
rows.name: Many noteworthy locations exist across the surface of Mira.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_025_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
These come in all kinds of forms, from iconic landmarks that identify
a particular region, to sprawling lakes and hills.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_025_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Some types of location may even grant you a reward when discovering
them for the first time.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_026_01_TITLE
rows.name: Becoming Incapacitated

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_026_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
When the character you're controlling reaches 0 HP, they become incapacitated.
Choose to return immediately, or wait 30 seconds to return to the last Landmark.
If your allies defeat the enemy within those 30 seconds, you win the battle.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_027_01_TITLE
rows.name: Enemy Detection Types

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_027_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Some enemies react to your presence by attacking.
Check the icon beside their level to see what they react to.
* Enemies at a much lower level than you generally won't attack.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_027_01_PAGE02
rows.name: Nonaggressive: No icon. Will not attack unless you attack it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_027_01_PAGE03
rows.name: Visual: Will react when you enter its field of vision.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_027_01_PAGE04
rows.name: Presence: Reacts when you get close.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_028_01_TITLE
rows.name: Time

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_028_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can change the current time from Main Menu > System >
Change Time. Not only do different people have different daily
routines, dangerous indigens also tend to prowl the night.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_028_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Certain enemies are also known to only come out at certain
times. Bear this in mind when searching for elusive prey.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_029_01_TITLE
rows.name: Weather

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_029_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Different zones on planet Mira experience different weather conditions.
Certain weather conditions may inflict buffs or debuffs on characters,
and some enemies appear only in particular weather.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_030_01_TITLE
rows.name: Running Away

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_030_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
When in battle, sheathe your weapon with [ST:icon p1=b ] and make some distance
from your enemies to run away from the fight. (Please note that
it is impossible to run away from scripted event battles.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_031_01_TITLE
rows.name: Hopper Camera

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_031_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
The Hopper Camera lets you view the surrounding terrain
from above. Press [ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=crsu ]
to activate it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_032_01_TITLE
rows.name: Information

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_032_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Information consists of rumors you can overhear from people.
Approach places where speech bubbles appear to hear them.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_032_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
In particular, yellow speech bubbles indicate valuable info, 
which will be recorded in Main Menu > Lists > Information.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_033_01_TITLE
rows.name: Melee and Ranged Weapons

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_033_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
The weapons you use on foot are split between melee and
ranged weapons. You can switch between them with [ST:icon p1=x ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_033_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Melee weapons:
Can only attack at close range.
Tend to do more damage per hit.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_033_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Ranged weapons:
Can attack at range. Tend to hit multiple times,
but damage per hit tends to be lower.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_033_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
When you use an Art, you'll automatically switch over to
the weapon that the Art is associated with: your melee weapon
for melee weapon Arts and your ranged weapon for ranged weapon Arts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_034_01_TITLE
rows.name: Double Cooldown for Arts

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_034_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Arts which are associated with the weapon you're currently
wielding (melee or ranged) will continue their cooldown even
after they're ready to use. This is called double cooldown.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_034_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Arts used at full double cooldown
will have a greatly increased effect.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_035_01_TITLE
rows.name: Changing Party Members

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_035_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can change your active party composition from
Main Menu > Change Party Members.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_035_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
There, you can select allies from the reserve and add them
to your active party, or swap them around. (Please note that
there are times when you will not be able to change members.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_036_01_TITLE
rows.name: Bonding Graph

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_036_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
The Bonding Graph is a relationship chart that shows each person's attributes
and bonds (connections) with others.
You can view it under Main Menu > Lists > Bonding Graph.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_038_01_TITLE
rows.name: Part Destruction

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_038_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Target a particular enemy part and attack it.
Reducing its part gauge to zero causes Part Destruction.
Select the part to attack with [ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=y ]/[ST:icon p1=a ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_038_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Destroying parts may also earn you
Part Destruction rewards after defeating the enemy.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_039_01_TITLE
rows.name: Battle Commands

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_039_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can issue battle commands via a special menu which you can open
while targeting an enemy or otherwise in combat. To open it, press [ST:icon p1=pls ].
From there, switch between categories with [ST:icon p1=crslr ] or press [ST:icon p1=pls ] again to close it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_039_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Items:
Use battle items.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_039_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Issue Orders:
Instruct party members on how to behave in battle.
(Change to whom the commands are issued with [ST:icon p1=crslr ].)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_039_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Withdraw:
If you can survive the next 15 seconds, you'll be returned to
the last landmark you have visited.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_040_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overeds

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_040_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overeds are powerful enemies with extraordinary abilities.
They bear special epithets, and their level displays are decorated.
Defeating them may yield valuable items.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_041_01_TITLE
rows.name: FrontierNET Spots

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_041_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
FrontierNET Spots are sites where data probes can be installed.
They're called FN Spots for short.
Installing a data probe can reveal the Segment Recon of adjacent segments.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_041_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can go to Main Menu > Map > Segments to see which
segments contain FrontierNET probe placement spots.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_042_01_TITLE
rows.name: Data Probes

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_042_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Data probes are devices to be planted on FN spots, designed to expand the
FrontierNET network. Each probe yields resources and credits periodically.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_042_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Furthermore, probes come in different types with various
special properties, which you can swap around to great effect.
(You can obtain them from quest rewards and treasure.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_042_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
To swap out a data probe, go to Main Menu > Map >
FrontierNET, then select a site with a probe already installed.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_043_01_TITLE
rows.name: Quests

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_043_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Quests are missions and requests you can accept from Mira's inhabitants or from the Quest Board.
There are four categories of quests.
Completing them can earn rewards and deepen your bonds with allies.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_043_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Story Quests:
Quests that advance the main story.
Accept them at the Story Quest sign in the BLADE Home.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_043_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Bonding Quests:
Side quests centered on your allies.
Accept them at Bonding Quest signs in various locations.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_043_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Normal Quests:
Quests involving requests primarily from NLA residents and BLADE members.
Accept them from people displaying a Normal Quest sign.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_043_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Simple Quests:
Quests with simple objectives such as defeating enemies or collecting items.
You can accept up to 20 at a time from the Quest Board.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_044_01_TITLE
rows.name: Augments

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_044_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Augments are items which can be set into empty slots
of your equipment to grant it additional effects. They come in
many different varieties, and help your characters get stronger.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_044_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
They are mainly obtained by developing them at Arms Manufacturers.
Development requires Materials, Rare Resources, and Miranium.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_045_01_TITLE
rows.name: Shopping

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_045_01_PAGE01
rows.name: Shopping allows you to buy equipment, sell items you no longer need, etc.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_045_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can access shops from the shop
console in the BLADE Area.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_046_01_TITLE
rows.name: Arms Manufacturers

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_046_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
At Arms Manufacturers, you can support companies,
enhance Affixes, create Augments,
and develop new equipment.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_046_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can access the Arms Manufacturers
from the AM Terminal in the BLADE Area.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_048_01_TITLE
rows.name: Affixes

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_048_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Affixes are fixed additional effects already attached to equipment.
Equipment sold in shops has predetermined Affixes,
while equipment dropped by enemies has random ones.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_048_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Affixes can also be enhanced at Arms Manufacturers.
The number of possible enhancements depends on the equipment.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_049_01_TITLE
rows.name: Collepedia

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_049_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
The Collepedia is a database where you can register collectible items.
To do so, go to Main Menu > Lists > Collepedia and choose a box marked
with an "OK." Note that you will lose one collectible item per registration.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_049_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Register a collectable in a highlighted slot to earn BP.
Completing a category grants another reward,
and completing a zone earns a generous completion reward.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_050_01_TITLE
rows.name: Skip Travel

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_050_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can "skip travel" instantly to any FN Spot you've already placed a probe
at, or any visited landmark. You can do this from Main Menu > Map.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_051_01_TITLE
rows.name: Unions

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_051_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Unions are the eight branches into which BLADE's duties are divided.
Union rewards vary by which Union you belong to.
You can change Unions at any time from the BLADE Home console.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_052_01_TITLE
rows.name: Special Arts Effects

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_052_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Certain Arts have special effects which only occur if the Art is used
from a certain position or at a certain time. These special effects may
take the form of extra damage, inflicting a debuff on the target, and more.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_052_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
The conditions for activating bonuses vary by Art.
You can check them on the Arts Setup screen.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_053_01_TITLE
rows.name: Toppling

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_053_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
First, inflict Break on an enemy with an Art, then use
one with the Topple effect to leave the enemy
unable to move for a while.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_053_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Your attacks are guaranteed to hit and deal more damage,
so make the most of opportunities to Topple enemies.
* If you skip Break, the enemy may not be Toppled.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_054_01_TITLE
rows.name: TP (Tension Points)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_054_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Tension points are mostly accrued by using auto-attacks,
and can be expended to perform certain special actions.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_054_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Tension Arts:
These Arts have powerful effects.
They cost 1000 TP to use.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_054_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Revive:
Approach an incapacitated ally and press [ST:icon p1=a ] to revive them.
This costs 3000 TP to perform.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_054_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
When reviving an ally, a green circle will appear.
Press [ST:icon p1=b ] at the right time to boost the healing provided
to the ally being revived.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_054_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Perfect: Restores 80% HP + grants 1000 TP (to revived ally)
Good: Restores 80% HP
Failed: Restores 30% HP

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_055_01_TITLE
rows.name: Navigation Ball

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_055_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
The Navigation Ball is a useful item which can display a route to guide you
to your currently active navigation target, like a quest objective, etc.
To launch it, press [ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=x ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_055_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can press [ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=x ] again to hide the route.
(This applies when the Navigation Ball is set to loop.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_055_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
You can change the Navigation Ball's behavior from
Main Menu > System > Settings > Game.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_055_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Sometimes the route shown may contain tough enemies
or be difficult to follow.
Try exploring different routes.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_055_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Additionally, you will not be able to launch the Navigation Ball
while on certain quests and during some segment recon
activities.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_056_01_TITLE
rows.name: Bonding

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_056_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Your Bonding level represents how close you are to an ally, on a scale of five levels.
Raising it may unlock certain Bonding Quests
or trigger Bonding Talks.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_056_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Bonds gradually deepen by choosing responses your allies agree with,
completing various quests, successfully answering their Soul Voices,
and through similar actions.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_070_01_TITLE
rows.name: Rankings

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_070_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can check various rankings for players from across the
world by going to Main Menu > Online > Rankings.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_070_01_PAGE02
rows.name: Be sure to check where you place among your peers!

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_073_01_TITLE
rows.name: Squad Missions

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_073_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Squad Missions are randomly generated every hour
while you're participating in a squad.
Each objective you complete earns you Material Tickets.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_073_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can check the status and time remaining for your current
squad missions in the squad mission tab of the navigation panel, opened
by pressing [ST:icon p1=anarp ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_073_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
A squad mission icon will mark your current tasks' targets.
Work together with your squadmates to achieve them all!

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_074_01_TITLE
rows.name: Online Missions

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_074_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Online missions trigger randomly every hour while you're part of
a squad, and can be accepted from the Network Console located
in the back of the BLADE Home.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_074_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Invite squad members to play in multiplayer with up to four people.
* You can also attempt them with four members of your own battle party.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_075_01_TITLE
rows.name: Map Survey Rate

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_075_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
The survey rate indicates the progress you've made in exploring
each region, and may be a requirement for accepting quests.
Check it from Main Menu > Map > Segments.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_075_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
The survey rate increases as you install data probes
and resolve Segment Recon.
Reaching certain survey rates earns you survey rewards.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_077_01_TITLE
rows.name: Bonding Talks

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_077_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Bonding Talks are special conversations
that occur when your bond with an ally reaches a certain level.
Viewing a Bonding Talk deepens your bond even further.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_077_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Bonding Talks can be triggered when the ally is not an
active member of your team, in places where the Bonding Talk
icon is shown.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_077_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Certain Bonding Talks have further requirements that must be
met before viewing them. You can check those by interacting
with the Bonding Talk icon in the game world or on the map.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_078_01_TITLE
rows.name: Bottomless Pits

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_078_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Bottomless pits are topographical features present in certain areas.
If you fall into one, your party will be incapacitated, whether on foot
or piloting Dolls.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_079_01_TITLE
rows.name: Ma-non Warp Device

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_079_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Approach the warp device near the entrance to BLADE Tower
and press [ST:icon p1=a ] to warp to the deck of the Ma-non Ship.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_080_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: LEGION

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_080_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
These are the Ares series' Overclock effects:
Increased accuracy and evasion, increased damage, shorter cooldowns,
and Heal Parts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_082_01_TITLE
rows.name: Lu's Shop

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_082_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
At Lu's humble establishment, you can spend miranium to
add empty slots to your equipment. (The maximum number
of slots that can be added depends on the item.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_083_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Flight Module

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_083_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
All your Dolls have been fitted with flight modules, enabling them to fly.
Press [ST:icon p1=zr ] mid-jump to shift into flight mode (if "Flight Module Jump Controls"
are set to "Jump"), and press [ST:icon p1=analp ] to fly at high speed. (Flight consumes fuel.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_085_01_TITLE
rows.name: Dolls

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_085_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Dolls are powerful weapons developed by humanity.
Press [ST:icon p1=zl ] to get in or out.
Use [ST:icon p1=analp ] to switch between walking and vehicle modes.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_085_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can explore Mira and fight in a Doll just as you can on foot.
However, Dolls cannot target certain parts of some enemies.
Fighting on foot is one strategy if you want to destroy those parts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_085_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
If you ever stray too far from your Doll, remember you can
go to Main Menu > Characters > Return to Doll to immediately
return to its cockpit.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_085_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
You can obtain new Dolls by buying them from the
shop terminal or by creating them. Check the Dolls
you own from the BLADE Home Console.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_085_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Also, bear in mind that your Arts selection while in a Doll depends on
the weapons it has equipped, so changing your weapon loadout will also
change the Arts you'll have access to.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_088_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Fuel

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_088_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Dolls have a limited supply of fuel, and will not be able to fight
when it runs out. Fuel is consumed in battle or when using Arts,
but will slowly regenerate while you're not piloting the Doll.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_088_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can also spend Miranium to refuel
through the Doll Garage on the BLADE Home Console.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_089_01_TITLE
rows.name: Registering Pilots

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_089_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Registering the character who will pilot a Doll
is called Pilot Registration.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_089_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
To use a Doll, a character must first be registered as its pilot
through the Doll Garage
on the BLADE Home Console.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_089_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
If you get your hands on a new Doll, be sure to first register
the character that you want to use as its pilot.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_090_01_TITLE
rows.name: Modifying Your Avatar

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_090_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
If you'd like to change your player avatar's appearance,
gender, etc., wait until late night, then go to Yardley's
hideaway, located beneath the BLADE Area.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_091_01_TITLE
rows.name: Segment Recon

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_091_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Segment Recon provide information on tasks assigned to each Segment.
They are represented by icons for each category.
Resolving them raises the map's survey rate.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_092_01_TITLE
rows.name: Segment Markers

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_092_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
When the Segment Recon for your current location has been revealed,
a yellow hexagonal area appears on the minimap.
This is called the Segment Marker.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_092_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
The segment marker indicates the borders of the segment
you're currently occupying.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_092_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
You can also go to Main Menu > Map > Segments, then
select a segment and press [ST:icon p1=anarp ] to manually display the segment marker
for that particular segment on the mini-map.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_092_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Manually-set segment markers will be displayed as a
blue hexagonal area even when you're outside their borders.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_093_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_093_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock is a special ability that temporarily enhances a character's combat capabilities.
Spend 3,000 TP to activate it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_093_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
During Overclock, all Art cooldowns are shortened, and Arts
can reach triple cooldown. The damage you deal is also 
increased, while enemy debuff resistance is lowered.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_093_01_PAGE03
rows.name: Overclock will end when the timer reaches zero.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_093_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
When activating Overclock while fighting on foot, you'll inflict
a large amount of damage to all enemies in battle.
The damage increases in proportion to your potential.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_093_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Note, however, that this damage will not be inflicted again
when reactivating Overclock while it's still running.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_094_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: Count-Up Effects

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_094_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
While Overclock is active, the Overclock Counter is displayed.
Combat capabilities and other effects improve according to the count.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_094_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
To increase the count, use offensive Arts of the same type in succession,
such as melee Art (orange) > melee Art or ranged Art (yellow) > ranged Art,
or[ST:wide ]—

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_094_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
use a debuff (purple), support (green), or aura (blue) Art
between a melee Art and a ranged Art (in either order).
The following effects occur according to the count:

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_094_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Damage: Increases damage dealt.
Cooldown: Shortens Art cooldown times.
Resistance: Lowers all enemy debuff resistances.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_094_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Extend Overclock: Extends Overclock duration by the specified number of seconds.
TP bonus: Increases TP gained when attacking.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_095_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: Color Combos

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_095_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
During Overclock, the color of the counter display will change
to match the color of the Arts that you use.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_095_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Certain color combinations (e.g. blue > green) will trigger
various bonus effects.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_096_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: Reactivation

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_096_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Spend another 3,000 TP while Overclock is active to reactivate it.
Reactivating extends its duration without resetting the Overclock Counter.
The damage effect on activation does not occur when reactivating.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_097_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: Party Chain

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_097_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
When allies also activate Overclock while yours is active, a Party Chain occurs,
granting additional effects.
Try ordering allies to activate it once they're able to do so.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_097_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Two active: Soul Voice occurrence rate increases by 50%.
Three active: Gain 50 TP when Arts hit.
Four active: Everyone takes half damage and gains Super Armor.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_097_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Super armor:
Immunity to Break, Topple, Knockback, Launch, and Flinch.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_099_01_TITLE
rows.name: Aura State

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_099_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Using aura Arts (designated with blue-colored icons) will
grant the character an aura effect that will make them stronger
for a certain period of time.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_099_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Aura Arts have various effects.
Some Arts have stronger effects when used while an Aura is active.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_100_01_TITLE
rows.name: FrontierNET

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_100_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
By going to Main Menu > Map > FrontierNET, you can check
the status of data probes currently installed at FN Spots
across Mira, as well as swap installed probes around.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_101_01_TITLE
rows.name: Rare Resources

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_101_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Rare Resources are rare crystals and minerals that are
automatically harvested from FN probe sites, often crucial
for creating gear and completing quests.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_102_01_TITLE
rows.name: Miranium

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_102_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Miranium is a versatile ore automatically mined at FN Spots.
In addition to equipment development and quest completion,
it has many uses, including company support and refueling Dolls.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_102_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Installing storage probes at FN Spots can help you by raising
the maximum amount of miranium you can store at one time.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_103_01_TITLE
rows.name: Quick Cooldown

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_103_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Filling an Art's cooldown gauge to use it immediately
is called Quick Cooldown.
Select an Art on cooldown and press [ST:icon p1=y ] to activate it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_103_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Activating Quick Cooldown consumes Aux Energy
according to the remaining cooldown time.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_103_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Spent Aux Energy is not restored during battle.
It is automatically replenished in full when the battle ends.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_103_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Acquiring special items called Energy Storage Units
increases your maximum Aux Energy.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_104_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Types

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_104_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Doll frames are divided into light, medium and heavy types,
each with its own broad range of Doll models that differ in
a variety of ways.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_104_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Light type: Low HP, but with good accuracy, evasion, and mobility.
Their fuel tanks are small, but they get good mileage in flight.
Low prices make them attractive to first-time buyers.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_104_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Medium Type: Balanced in all respects and easy to handle.
Its armor has high durability, making parts difficult to destroy.
Slightly more expensive, but recommended for pilots familiar with Doll combat.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_104_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Heavy type: Highest HP and defense, and a large fuel tank,
but not very nimble in combat, and burns through fuel quickly
in flight. Costs a lot, but with features to compensate.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_105_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Gear

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_105_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can change your Dolls' loadouts from Main Menu >
Characters > Doll Gear > Doll Weapons / Doll Armor.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_106_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Weapons

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_106_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Dolls can be equipped with their own weapons. Each Doll can equip
weapons in five positions on the left and right sides, for a total of ten.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_106_01_PAGE02
TIPS_BSC_106_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Additionally, some Doll weapons occupy more than one
equipment slot. When equipping one of these, icons will be
placed between Art icons on the Arts Palette to indicate this.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_107_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Armor

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_107_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Armor components can be installed on Dolls, each one
tied to one of five slots. These do not affect Doll appearance.
The armor pieces a Doll can equip are governed by its type.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_107_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Light type: Light armor only.
Medium type: Light or medium armor only.
Heavy type: Can equip all types of armor.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_114_01_TITLE
rows.name: World Enemy Battles

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_114_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
These missions bring all players together to fight a formidable enemy.
Take them on from the Network Console at the back of the BLADE Home.
* You must be participating in a squad.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_114_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
There are two World Enemies, Telethia Plume
and Yegiras, the Zero Emperor, which appear at regular intervals.
Check the squad selection screen for the next appearance.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_114_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
A World Enemy's HP is shared by all players as RP.
The more RP you take away, the greater the rewards you receive.
Work together with all players to defeat it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_114_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Once a World Enemy is defeated, the reward items can be collected
by going to Main Menu > Online > Rewards > World Enemy Rewards.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_115_01_TITLE
rows.name: Material Tickets

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_115_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
These tickets can be exchanged for various enemy materials.
To use them, go to Main Menu > Online > Rewards > Material Exchange.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_115_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Material Tickets can be obtained by completing Squad Mission objectives
and through map survey rate rewards, among other means.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_116_01_TITLE
rows.name: Battle Items

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_116_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Battle Items are items whose effects are mainly used in battle,
such as restoring HP or increasing TP.
Select Items from [ST:icon p1=pls ] Battle Commands to use them.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_116_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
The main way to obtain battle items is through
Main Menu > Online > Rewards > Union Rewards.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_119_01_TITLE
rows.name: Time Attack Missions

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_119_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Time Attack Missions are special missions
undertaken with four members of your battle party.
Take them on from the Network Console at the back of the BLADE Home.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_119_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
If you're a member of a squad (playing in online mode) when you
complete the mission, your result will be reflected in the rankings.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_121_01_TITLE
rows.name: Union Rewards

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_121_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can claim Union Rewards once a day
under Main Menu > Online > Rewards > Union Rewards.
The more allies you've recruited, the more reward types and items you'll receive.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_123_01_TITLE
rows.name: Supporting Arms Manufacturers

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_123_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Support Arms Manufacturers is one of the AM Terminal functions.
Contributing a certain amount of Miranium to a company of your choice raises its company level
and makes new gear available in the shop.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_124_01_TITLE
rows.name: Upgrading Affixes

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_124_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Upgrade Affixes is one of the AM Terminal functions.
It lets you upgrade Affixes (additional effects) attached to equipment.
Upgrading requires Materials obtained from enemies.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_125_01_TITLE
rows.name: Creating Augments

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_125_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Create Augments is one of the AM Terminal functions.
It lets you create Augments to insert into vacant equipment slots.
Creation requires Materials, Rare Resources and Miranium.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_125_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can also dismantle Augments you no longer need
to recover Materials and Rare Resources.
* Dismantling consumes Miranium.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_126_01_TITLE
rows.name: Developing New Gear

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_126_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Develop New Gear is one of the AM Terminal functions.
It lets you develop and acquire powerful gear not sold in the shop.
Development requires Materials, Rare Resources and Miranium.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_127_01_TITLE
rows.name: Material Tracking

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_127_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Material Tracking lets you track Materials needed to upgrade Affixes,
create Augments, and so on, in the navigation panel.
You can register them from each relevant function at the AM Terminal.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_127_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Materials set for tracking can be double-checked in the
Material Tracking category of the navigation panel.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_127_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Enemies that can provide the required materials
will also display a Material Tracking icon.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_128_01_TITLE
rows.name: Inner Level

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_128_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
This indicates a character's experience level.
Raising the level increases HP and other stats.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_128_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Experience points necessary to increase the level can be
gained by defeating enemies, discovering new locations, etc.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_129_01_TITLE
rows.name: Arts Setup

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_129_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Go to Main Menu > Characters > Arts Setup to set your preferred Arts,
arrange their layout on the palette, or upgrade them.
(Upgrading Arts requires BP.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_129_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Bear in mind, however, that your Arts Palette can only contain Arts
specific to the weapons your current class can equip.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_130_01_TITLE
rows.name: BP (Battle Points)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_130_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
BP is required to strengthen Arts and Skills.
You can earn it by raising your Inner Level or class rank, registering items in the Collepedia,
recovering treasure boxes, and so on.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_131_01_TITLE
rows.name: Important Items

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_131_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Important Items are special items obtained during quests and similar activities.
They are required to complete quests.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_132_01_TITLE
rows.name: Classes

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_132_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
A character's class defines their fighting style,
dictating the weapons they use and their basic stats,
as well as what Arts and skills they can learn.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_133_01_TITLE
rows.name: Changing Class

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_133_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Only your own avatar can change to a higher class when the current class reaches rank 10.
You can do this under Main Menu > Characters > Change Class.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_134_01_TITLE
rows.name: Cockpit Mode

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_134_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Using a Doll Art may trigger Cockpit Mode.
When it activates, all Arts are recharged,
you become invincible for a time, and GP increases.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_135_01_TITLE
rows.name: Collectibles

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_135_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Collectibles are items you can pick up while out and about in
the field. You can use them to fill in the Collepedia, or to
complete quests.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_136_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock (Doll)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_136_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Just like when you're on foot, you can spend 3000 GP while
piloting a Doll to activate Overclock. While it's active, fuel will
not be consumed, and Cockpit Mode will trigger more often.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_136_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Additionally, a Doll's capabilities will be greatly enhanced
during Overclock, but the exact perks differ from Doll to Doll.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_137_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: JINRAI

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_137_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock effects for the Formula series:
Accuracy & Evasion Up, Critical Chance Up, and Recast Up.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_138_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: OBORO

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_138_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock effects for the Urban series:
Damage Dealt Up, Ranged Damage Taken Down, and Heal Parts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_139_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: HAGANE

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_139_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock effects for the Wels series and POLICEMEN:
Melee Weapon Attack Up, Heal Parts, and 2x Damage Reflect: Physical.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_140_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: NAGI

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_140_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock effects for the Lailah series:
Heal Time, Heal Parts, Damage Taken Down, and Debuff Immunity.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_141_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: HIBANA

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_141_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock effects for the Inferno series:
Heal Parts, Ranged Weapon Attack Up, and 2x Damage Reflect: Heat.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_142_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: GEKITETSU

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_142_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock effects for the Mastema series:
Increased ranged attack, 2x Damage Reflect: Beam, and Damage Taken Down.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_143_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: KURENAI

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_143_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock effects for the Amdusias series:
Melee Attack Fuel Absorption, Double Crash, and Melee Weapon Attack Up.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_144_01_TITLE
rows.name: Soul Voice Setup

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_144_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Go to Main Menu > Characters > Soul Voice Setup to manually set up
the bonus effects for successful Soul Voices, but only for the
player character. You can choose one of three effects per trigger.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_145_01_TITLE
rows.name: Catch

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_145_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
When piloting a Doll, approach a large enemy affected by Break
and press [ST:icon p1=zl ] + [ST:icon p1=zr ] to use Catch.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_145_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Catch restrains an enemy for a set amount of time.
While held, all attacks against the enemy will hit,
and deal increased damage.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_145_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
While using Catch, purple circles appear one after another.
Press [ST:icon p1=b ] at the right time to extend Catch
and rapidly recover fuel.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_146_01_TITLE
rows.name: Treasure Boxes

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_146_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Treasure boxes of various shapes can be found in the field.
Approach one and hold [ST:icon p1=a ] to obtain items, money, experience, BP,
and other rewards.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_146_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Some cannot be opened without advanced techniques.
Complete various quests to discover how to open them.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_147_01_TITLE
rows.name: Fashion Gear

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_147_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Go to Main Menu > Characters > Fashion Gear to be able to
change your party members' appearance without affecting
the gear they've actually got equipped, stats and all.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_147_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Each time you obtain new inner armor, the equivalent
fashion gear option will be added to your collection.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_149_01_TITLE
rows.name: BLADE Home Customization

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_149_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
This menu can be accessed from the BLADE Home Console.
You can change the colors and decals of the BLADE Home interior.
Completing certain quests also lets you place pets there.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_150_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Garage

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_150_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Accessed via the BLADE Home Console in the BLADE Home.
Use this menu to register pilots, and to outfit and refuel your Dolls.
You can even change your machines' paintjobs.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_151_01_TITLE
rows.name: Holofigures

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_151_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Holofigures are holographic figures
you can display in the gallery at the BLADE Home.
They can be acquired through quest rewards, certain enemy drops, and so on.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_152_01_TITLE
rows.name: BLADE Scout

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_152_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Recruiting other players' avatars is called BLADE Scout.
You can recruit up to three at a time for a limited duration.
Do so at the BLADE Scout Console in BLADE Concourse.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_152_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Help the recruited BLADE operatives grow, and you may
just be rewarded. You can monitor their progress via the
gauge located below and to the right of their portrait.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_152_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Caution: If you remove the BLADE from your active party,
they will be released immediately and return to their creator.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_153_01_TITLE
rows.name: Registering and Deleting Your Avatar

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_153_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
By registering your avatar,
you allow other players to scout you.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_153_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
When your avatar is scouted,
you can claim Scout Rewards.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_153_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
We recommend enabling Auto-Upload My Avatar
under Main Menu > System > Settings > Online.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_153_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
If you no longer wish to be scouted, you can always
remove your avatar registration.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_154_01_TITLE
rows.name: Overclock: MOROHA

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_154_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Overclock effects for YUMBO and EXCAVATOR:
Accuracy & Evasion Up, Damage Dealt Up, and Reverse Damage.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_156_01_TITLE
rows.name: Skills

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_156_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Classes more advanced than the Drifter can learn skills,
which provide various effects just by being equipped.
Different classes have different skills they can learn.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_157_01_TITLE
rows.name: Weapon Mastery

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_157_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Reaching rank 10 in the final class of any class branch
grants Weapon Mastery.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_157_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Weapon Mastery allows you to equip the weapons and Arts
of the mastered class even when using another class.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_158_01_TITLE
rows.name: GP (Gear Points)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_158_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Gear points are points necessary for activating Overclock while
piloting a Doll. They accrue from auto-attacks, certain Arts,
Cockpit Mode activations, hitting Perfect in Catch prompts, etc.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_159_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Defense Effect

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_159_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
When any party members are piloting Dolls, any members who
are not will gain a Doll defense bonus (damage reduction) effect,
proportional to the number of deployed Dolls.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_159_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
1 Doll: 20% increase
2 Dolls: 40% increase
3 Dolls: 60% increase

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_160_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Part Destruction

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_160_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
When a Doll's part is destroyed,
it can no longer attack with the weapon equipped on that part.
Destroyed parts are restored after battle.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_161_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Destruction

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_161_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
When a Doll's HP drops to zero, it will be totally destroyed.
At the same time, a red circle will appear. Press [ST:icon p1=b ] at the right
time to reduce the penalty for the Doll's destruction.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_161_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Perfect: Do not use Doll insurance, eject safely.
Good: Use Doll insurance, eject safely.
Failed: Use Doll insurance, pilot's HP is reduced to 1.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_162_01_TITLE
rows.name: Doll Insurance

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_162_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
If a Doll's HP reaches 0 and it is destroyed,
it disappears from the area,
but it can be repaired using Doll Insurance.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_162_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Open BLADE Home Console > Doll Garage
to board your automatically recovered and serviced Doll.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_162_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
If a Doll is destroyed while you have no Doll insurance remaining, and even
if you succeed perfectly in the red [ST:icon p1=b ] prompt, you'll have to either spend a
large sum of money or use a salvage ticket to get it retrieved and repaired.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_163_01_TITLE
rows.name: Segments

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_163_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Go to Main Menu > Map > Segments to check details on
segment recon for each segment, and the location of segments
containing FN probe placement sites.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_165_01_TITLE
rows.name: Schematics

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_165_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Schematics (FILEs) can be obtained by completing certain quests
or opening treasure boxes.
* They are not displayed in the Item List after acquisition.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_165_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Obtaining a Blueprint
enables you to develop new gear at Arms Manufacturers.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_166_01_TITLE
rows.name: Online Mode and Offline Mode

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_166_01_PAGE01
rows.name: This title supports both online and offline play.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_166_01_PAGE02
rows.name: To play in online mode, you will have to join a squad.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_166_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Joining a squad requires an active membership
to online services.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_166_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
If you'd like to always play in offline mode, select the
"Hide" option after selecting offline mode.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_167_01_TITLE
rows.name: Social Information

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_167_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Social Information is information about squad members and friends
shown in the upper-left corner of the screen
while participating in a squad.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_167_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
This may include various pieces of information about other
players in your squad, World Enemies, squad missions, 
scouting, and so on.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_168_01_TITLE
rows.name: BLADE Members in the Field

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_168_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
As long as you're a member of a squad, you might see
BLADE operatives hanging out at the BLADE Home
or at base camps.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_168_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
If you ask them to join your party, they'll gladly fight
alongside you for an hour. Be sure to take advantage of
this if you're short on active party members.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_169_01_TITLE
rows.name: Data Probe Link Combos

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_169_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Installing high-performance data probes of the same type
next to one another creates a chain combo
and enhances their effects.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_169_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
3-chain combo: 30% increase
5-chain combo: 50% increase
8-chain combo: 80% increase

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_170_01_TITLE
rows.name: BLADE Reports

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_170_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
BLADE reports are a communication tool that residents
of Mira use to share useful information they come across.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_170_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
When you visit a segment for which you haven't completed
the segment recon yet, you may receive a BLADE report post.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_170_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
When you receive a post,
check the details of the Segment Recon
and try to resolve it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_172_01_TITLE
rows.name: Energy Storage Units

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_172_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Energy Storage Units increase the maximum amount of Aux Energy
needed to activate Quick Cooldown.
You can obtain them as survey rate rewards by increasing Mira's survey rate.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_174_01_TITLE
rows.name: Critical Hits

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_174_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Whenever you deal damage with an auto-attack or Art,
there's a certain chance that a critical hit will occur,
dealing more damage than normal.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_174_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Weapon battle traits such as "Critical Chance Up" and buffs
like "Critical Power" can increase the chances of landing
critical hits or improve the critical damage ratio.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_175_01_TITLE
rows.name: Pets

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_175_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You can change the pet placed in the BLADE Home
through BLADE Home Customization on the BLADE Home Console.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_175_01_PAGE02
rows.name: You can unlock new pets by completing certain simple quests.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_175_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Some Bonding Talks occur only when particular pets are placed.
Complete Simple Quests actively to acquire more pets.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_176_01_TITLE
rows.name: Miran Archives

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_176_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
The Miran archives allow you to read synopses of past story
quests, or look up the meanings of important terms.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_176_01_PAGE02
rows.name: You can find them in Main Menu > System > Miran Archives.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_176_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
The descriptions in each article will be updated as you
complete the relevant story quests, etc.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_177_01_TITLE
rows.name: How Can I Restore HP in Battle?

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_177_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Respond to Soul Voice prompts![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Using an Art that matches the color of the Soul Voice issued by
an ally will restore some HP for both you and the ally.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_177_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. React to Soul Challenges![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Pressing [ST:icon p1=b ] at the right time to match the orange circle prompt
that sometimes appears will restore HP for the whole party.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_177_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Make use of healing Arts[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Certain Arts, such as Maintenance, restore HP.
Learn various Arts and build a setup that suits you.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_178_01_TITLE
rows.name: When Should I Use My Arts?

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_178_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Use Arts marked with a "!" icon[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Certain Arts become more effective under particular conditions.
A "!" icon appears when those conditions are met, so use those Arts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_178_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
For example, "Slit Edge" deals far more damage when it
hits an enemy from the side.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_178_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Similarly, Elma's Art "Shadow Strike" hits much harder
when it hits an enemy from behind.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_178_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
There are many other Arts like this. If the conditions are met,
some may even restore TP or apply additional debuffs.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_179_01_TITLE
rows.name: Strengthening Arts in Battle

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_179_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Wait for double cooldown to charge![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
