Letting an Art's cooldown gauge fully charge up twice puts
the Art in double cooldown state.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_179_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Double Cooldown effects vary by Art, including greatly increased damage,
successive uses of the Art, and higher buff levels.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_179_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Set up melee or ranged combos![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
You can trigger melee (or ranged) combo effects by chaining a melee
(or ranged) weapon Art into the Art with combo-specific criteria.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_179_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
A successful combo will deal increased damage, or have some
additional effect depending on the Art, like applying a debuff.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_180_01_TITLE
rows.name: Using Arts Right Away

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_180_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Make use of Quick Cooldown[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Select an Art on cooldown and press [ST:icon p1=y ]
to fill its cooldown gauge and use it immediately.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_180_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
This is useful when you need an Art at a moment's notice,
such as to respond to an ally's Soul Voice or use Powered Dive,
which grants complete evasion while active, against a powerful enemy attack.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_180_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Activating it requires Aux Energy.
Aux Energy recovers after battle,
so your opportunities to use it within any one battle are limited.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_180_01_PAGE04
rows.name: Be sure to choose your moments wisely.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_181_01_TITLE
rows.name: Strengthening Your Character: Experience

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_181_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Find some locations![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Locations can be found all over Mira, and many of them grant
experience points just for discovering them.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_181_01_PAGE02
rows.name: Be sure to search Mira from corner to corner.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_181_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Do some quests![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Completing quests awards experience points. You can look
for quests to accept from Main Menu > Map.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_181_01_PAGE04
rows.name: Aim to complete as many different quests as you can.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_181_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Fight some stronger enemies![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Beating enemies that are higher level awards more experience
points. Conversely, weaker enemies are worth much less.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_182_01_TITLE
rows.name: Strengthening Your Character: Classes

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_182_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Set your sights on advanced classes![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Once the player avatar reaches Rank 10 in a class,
they can change their class to a more advanced one.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_182_01_PAGE02
rows.name: More advanced classes can learn many powerful Arts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_182_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Reaching Rank 10 in a final-tier class will also let you equip
that class's weapons and Arts even while using other classes.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_182_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Strengthen your Arts[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Spend BP on the Arts Setup screen to strengthen them.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_182_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Upgrading Arts not only increases their effects, but it can also
shorten their cooldown times, letting you use them more often.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_182_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Set and upgrade your skills![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Like Arts, skills can also be upgraded. Try thinking of skills
and Arts that could be combined to build synergy.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_183_01_TITLE
rows.name: Obtaining Powerful Gear

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_183_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Improve the shop terminal's selection![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Remember that supplying arms manufacturers with miranium
will lead to new products being introduced to the marketplace.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_183_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
This expands the selection of Dolls
as well as weapons and armor,
so make an effort to support their development.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_TITLE
rows.name: Understanding the Various Stats

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Melee Attack and Total Melee Attack:[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Melee attack is the stat associated with characters, while
total melee attack is the sum of the character and weapon's.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Ranged Attack and Total Ranged Attack:[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Ranged attack is the stat associated with characters, while
total ranged attack is the sum of the character and weapon's.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
The higher a character's total melee and total ranged attack, the more
damage they'll deal with auto-attacks and Arts for a given weapon category.
(Tension Art damage is instead governed by the "potential" stat.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Melee and Ranged Accuracy:[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Affects the accuracy with the respective weapon category.
If it's too low, your attacks against some enemies may miss.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Potential:[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Affects the amount of HP restored by Soul Voices,
as well as damage dealt with Tension Arts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
If your combat strategy relies heavily on Tension Arts,
it may be worth prioritizing your potential.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE07
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Defense and Attribute Resistance:[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Defense reduces the overall damage you take. Similarly, each resistance
reduces damage from sources with that attribute. Higher values = less damage.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE08
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]Evasion:[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
This value dictates the likelihood of dodging enemy attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_184_01_PAGE09
rows.name:
This stat is mainly associated with characters, but it can be
raised with augments and affixes.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_185_01_TITLE
rows.name: Gaining the Advantage in Battle

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_185_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Make use of Augments[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Augments attached to weapons and armor can offer powerful effects,
such as stat boosts, bonuses against certain species, and attribute boosts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_185_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
For example, slotting in Weapon Attack Power Up augments
can increase a weapon's attack power by up to 100%.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_185_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Beast Criticals Up augments can increase your critical
chance against Beast-type enemies by up to 50 points.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_185_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Try to take less damage from enemies![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Enemy attacks are all associated with a particular attribute,
and augments can improve your resistance to those.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_185_01_PAGE05
rows.name: Try improving your resistances alongside your defense stat.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_185_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
You can try to cover your weaknesses, or tailor your augments
to be more effective against the enemy you're trying to defeat.
Try out whatever you think might give you the edge in battle.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_TITLE
rows.name: Mastering Overclock

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Raise the Overclock Counter for stronger effects[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
First, try using melee Arts (orange)
or ranged Arts (yellow) in succession.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
When the Art colors go orange > orange or yellow > yellow,
the Overclock Counter increases according to the number of hits the Art lands.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
The higher you can get the counter, the stronger the Overclock
bonuses (extended duration, increased damage, TP gain, etc.)
will be, so try to get the counter as high as you can.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Hit some color combos![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Changing the color of the Overclock counter in certain orders triggers
combo effects. It's worth setting Arts of different colors to your palette.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Try these color combos for starters![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Green > Any color: Double Overclock count bonus
Any Art you use after a green one will provide double the count.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE06
rows.name: Use Arts which hit many times to maximize your count gains.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE07
rows.name:
Blue > Green: HP recovery
Use a blue Art followed by a green one to regain some HP.
This is particularly useful when you're running low on health.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE08
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]4. Extend the Overclock![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
If you reactivate Overclock while it's still active, you can
extend its duration.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE09
rows.name:
Augments that raise your maximum TP or grant TP when using Arts,
such as Arts + TP,
make it easier to extend Overclock.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE10
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]5. Practice in the Damage Trial![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Damage Trial challenges, accessed through the
BLADE Home Console, let you start battles with full TP.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_186_01_PAGE11
rows.name:
This is an easy way to practice using Overclock over and over,
so feel free to run through a few rounds if you're feeling unsure.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_TITLE
rows.name: After Getting a Doll License

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Remember that Doll Arts are dictated by the weapons![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Dolls have up to 8 weapon slots for equipping weapons that
give access to Arts, and those weapons dictate the Arts you use.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Therefore, your first priority should be to make sure that you've
got a weapon equipped in each and every one of those slots.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Get some high-level Dolls![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
The higher level a Doll frame is, the stronger the weapons and
armor it's able to equip, and the better its stats will be.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
However, you cannot pilot a Doll whose frame level exceeds
your own Inner Level.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Keep your Doll fueled up![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Doll fuel will slowly recover over time once you disembark,
or you can spend miranium to refuel it at the Home Doll Garage.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]4. If your Doll is destroyed[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
You can repair the frame at the Doll Garage
on the BLADE Home Console.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_PAGE07
rows.name:
Repairs cost a large sum if Doll Insurance has run out,
so try to keep your remaining insurance claims from reaching zero.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_187_01_PAGE08
rows.name:
You can also avoid using up Doll insurance if you manage
to press [ST:icon p1=b ] at just the right time during the red circle prompt
that appears at the moment of your Doll's destruction.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_188_01_TITLE
rows.name: Exploring the Field

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_188_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Look for treasure![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
You can sometimes find treasure at tops of cliffs or deep within
caves. If you get stuck, try searching around for another way.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_188_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Defeat powerful enemies to obtain valuable items[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Enemies called Overeds have high equipment drop rates
and may drop Holofigures to display in the BLADE Home.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_188_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Raise your survey rate to earn rewards[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Raising each zone's survey rate earns rewards based on that rate.
Resolve the recon objectives shown for each Segment to raise it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_188_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Segment recon will note the treasure's appearance, if relevant.
Some Overeds also only appear at certain times or in certain
weather, and these conditions will be noted there too.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_189_01_TITLE
rows.name: When Unsure Where to Go

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_189_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Set a quest to track in the navigation panel![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
You can pin a quest you're pursuing to the navigation panel
by finding it in Main Menu > Quests and pressing [ST:icon p1=y ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_189_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Once it's tracked, you'll be able to see the objectives you'll
need to complete in the navigation panel on the bottom right
of the screen.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_189_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
You'll also see an exclamation mark near the location of
your objective. (But not for every quest.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_189_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Additionally, you'll be able to press [ST:icon p1=l ] + [ST:icon p1=y ] to open your map
to the vicinity of your current objective.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_189_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Try using the Navigation Ball![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
The Navigation Ball is a useful item that can show you the route
to your destination.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_189_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
Simply press [ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=x ], and a path to the objective
set in your navigation panel will appear before you.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_189_01_PAGE07
rows.name:
You can press [ST:icon p1=r ] + [ST:icon p1=x ] again to hide the route.
(These instructions apply when the Navigation Ball is set to loop.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_190_01_TITLE
rows.name: Gathering Allies on Planet Mira

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_190_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. How to recruit allies[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Completing Bonding Quests
may cause new characters to join you.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_190_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Check the conditions for recruiting allies under Recruitment Hint
in Main Menu > Change Party Members.
* Information is updated as you progress through Story Quests and so on.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_190_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Deepen your bonds with allies[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
As you recruit more allies, add them to your battle party and adventure together
to deepen your bonds.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_190_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Deepening your bonds
may unlock new Bonding Quests
or let you view allies' Bonding Talks.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_190_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
You can check your bonding with your allies on the
Change Party Members screen, or on the Bonding Graph.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_TITLE
rows.name: Taking on Quests

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Advance the story![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Story Quests advance the game's main story.
You can accept them in the BLADE Home.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Complete Bonding Quests[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Bonding Quests are side quests centered on your allies.
Accept them at Bonding Quest signs in various locations.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Completing them may cause new characters to join you
or allow you to learn new Arts,
so make an effort to take them on.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
You cannot accept Bonding Quests and story quests
at the same time, so keep that in mind.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Complete Normal Quests[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
These mainly involve fulfilling requests from NLA residents and BLADE members.
Accept them from people displaying Normal Quest signs.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
Completing them may let you meet various people
and deepen your bonds with them.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE07
rows.name:
They also come with experience and credit rewards,
so they're worth your time.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE08
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]4. And don't forget the simple quests![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
These are simple tasks, like defeating enemies or collecting
items. You can accept up to 20 at a time from Quest Board.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE09
rows.name:
Some Simple Quests
develop into Bonding Quests or Normal Quests.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_191_01_PAGE10
rows.name:
The simple quests you can take on at Quest Board are
updated as you advance through the story quests. Be sure
to check the board periodically and do them at your leisure.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_192_01_TITLE
rows.name: When You Need More of Something

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_192_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Short on miranium? Do this![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Be sure to check FN Spots via FrontierNET, and install
high-grade mining probes on sites with high miranium output.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_192_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Short on rare resources? Do this![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Check FN Spots for mineable resources via FrontierNET. If you
see one that has what you need, install a mining probe there.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_192_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Short on credits? Do this![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Install research probes at FN Spots.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_192_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
The more secret and scenic locations you've discovered near an FN Spot,
the greater the potential increase to total revenue.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_192_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]4. How to obtain data probes[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
They can be obtained as quest rewards and from treasure boxes.
Complete a variety of quests as you explore planet Mira.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_193_01_TITLE
rows.name: Making Use of Material Tickets

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_193_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Material tickets can be exchanged for materials that are
normally dropped by defeated enemies.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_193_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Many rare Materials are available through the exchange,
so make good use of it when creating equipment or Augments.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_TITLE
rows.name: How Do I Get Material Tickets?

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Complete Squad Mission objectives[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Defeating target enemies or obtaining target Collectibles
earns you Material Tickets.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Completing all tasks will reward all squad members with
a bounty of material tickets.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Recruit and train BLADEs[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Recruited BLADEs can progress through up to three stages
by gaining Inner experience.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
You can collect material tickets as a reward for each
scout level that a scouted BLADE attains.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Collect scout rewards![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
If another player scouts your avatar, you'll be able to collect
scouting rewards upon their return.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
Customize your avatar to make it more appealing
to other players looking to hire someone.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_PAGE07
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]4. Complete online missions![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Completing online missions can also grant material tickets
as part of the reward.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_194_01_PAGE08
rows.name:
Additionally, whenever another member of your squad
completes an online mission, you might also receive a small
number of material tickets.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_195_01_TITLE
rows.name: Getting Rare Materials from World Enemies

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_195_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
World Enemies drop rare materials that are unique to them.
These are used in creating many powerful pieces of gear, so
be sure to take a stab at them whenever they appear.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_195_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Rewards for World Enemy battles are decided based on the
amount of RP you're able to claim, but even just taking part
grants a small reward of materials, so don't be discouraged.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_195_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
There is a limit to how many times you can fight a World Enemy
after it has spawned, but this limited number of attempts will be
reset some time after the spawn.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_196_01_TITLE
rows.name: Recommended Early-game Arts

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_196_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Arts with short cooldowns![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Drifter's Slit Edge and Assault's Rising Blade are easy to get
a handle on, and useful for matching Soul Voice prompts.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_196_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. Arts that inflict the topple debuff![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
The topple debuff, inflicted by Drifter's Assault Hammer etc.,
is useful for immobilizing enemies and creating opportunities.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_196_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Arts that build TP[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Command's Slide Burst lets you earn TP more quickly.
Upgrading the Art increases the amount gained.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_196_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]4. Arts that restore HP[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Arts that restore HP, such as Forcer's Maintenance,
are indispensable in battles against higher-level enemies.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_196_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]5. Arts that evade attacks[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Assault's Powered Dive lets you dodge an enemy's attacks,
so try timing it to coincide with powerful attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_197_01_TITLE
rows.name: Damage Trial

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_197_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
This simulator lets you practice combat against training enemies.
Start it under BLADE Home Console > Damage Trial.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_197_01_PAGE02
rows.name: The Damage Trial begins when you attack the training enemy.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_197_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
During the Damage Trial, you can attack the training enemy
as much as you like within the time limit.
(The training enemy will not attack you.)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_197_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Once time runs out or you put away your weapons, the Damage Trial
will end and your trial results will be displayed.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_197_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
The results show total damage dealt within the time limit,
the time limit, and damage dealt per second.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_197_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
To return to the BLADE Home, press [ST:icon p1=pls ] to open the
Damage Trial menu, then select End Damage Trial.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_198_01_TITLE
rows.name: Damage Trial Menu

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_198_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
This is a special menu that can be opened with [ST:icon p1=pls ]
during a Damage Trial challenge.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_198_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Trial Duration Settings lets you choose the Damage Trial's time limit
from 1:00 to 8:00.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_198_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Character Settings lets you customize
equipment, Arts, and other settings.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_198_01_PAGE04
rows.name: You can also select End Damage Trial to return to the BLADE Home.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_198_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Parameter Settings lets you adjust
what happens when TP, Aux Energy,
and similar resources are consumed.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_TITLE
rows.name: How Do I Use FrontierNET?

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]1. Open FrontierNET often![ST:col p1=lightblue ]
You can check the placement of your data probes and swap them out
for other types as needed via the FrontierNET system.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_PAGE02
rows.name: Press [ST:icon p1=l ]/[ST:icon p1=r ] on the map screen to switch over to FrontierNET.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]2. What are data probes?[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
Data probes are devices installed at FN Spots
to expand FrontierNET.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Once you've installed a data probe at an FN Spot, you'll then periodically
receive resources and cash from it.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
You can also check the details of that FN Spot via FrontierNET from
the moment your data probe has been placed.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
[ST:col p1=blue ]3. Try exchanging data probes[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
There are several types of data probes with different effects and capabilities.
Exchanging them produces various effects according to their types.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_PAGE07
rows.name:
To swap out a data probe, select an FN Spot that you've already
installed a probe at, and press [ST:icon p1=a ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_199_01_PAGE08
rows.name:
Whenever you come across a new type of data probe, take the time to revisit
your FN Spot info and see if it makes sense to replace any of your previously
installed probes with a more efficient model!

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_200_01_TITLE
rows.name: Energy Drifting Around the Floating Continent

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_200_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Simply touch the purple energy floating around the Floating Continent and your Dolls
will be supplemented with additional fuel.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_202_01_TITLE
rows.name: Reviving Allies

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_202_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
If one of your allies has 3,000 TP stored up, they can expend it to help up
an allied character who's been incapacitated in battle.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_203_01_TITLE
rows.name: Enemy Groups

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_203_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Some enemies form groups and fight using team tactics.
Whenever you're noticed by an enemy who is part of a group,
all other members of that group will attack along with them.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_204_01_TITLE
rows.name: Enemy Reinforcements

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_204_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Certain enemies will attack you if they sense members of the same category
fighting nearby. Enemies with this ability can be distinguished by the spiky
detection type icons next to their level indicator, as shown on this image.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_205_01_TITLE
rows.name: Weapon Power Rating

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_205_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Weapon Power Rating indicates a weapon's basic strength.
If you're unsure what to equip,
try equipping a weapon with a high value.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_206_01_TITLE
rows.name: Melee and Ranged Weapon Arts

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_206_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Arts are broadly divided into two types: melee weapon Arts and ranged weapon Arts.
This classification affects the conditions for Double Cooldown, which weapon you switch to after an Art,
and the activation of melee and ranged combos.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_206_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can tell whether an Art is a melee weapon or ranged weapon
by checking the design of the Art's icon border.
(Left: melee weapon Art, right: ranged weapon Art)

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_207_01_TITLE
rows.name: Setting as Favorite or Junk

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_207_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
You have the option to flag the items you collect as either favorite or junk.
This feature allows you to more efficiently manage and sort through
any items you consider particularly valuable, or, conversely, unnecessary.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_207_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Items set as favorite will be marked with a star, and can be found easily
by using the correct sorting option. They are also safe from being sold
by accident.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_207_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
To set an item as favorite, simply hover over it on any
equipment or inventory screen, then press [ST:icon p1=y ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_207_01_PAGE04
rows.name:
Items categorized as junk will be moved to the bottom of every item list,
making the feature perfect for filtering out items you don't need.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_207_01_PAGE05
rows.name:
Additionally, if you go to Main Menu > Lists > Item List and select any
category of items, you can press [ST:icon p1=zr ] to sell all items categorized
as junk in one go.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_207_01_PAGE06
rows.name:
To set an item as junk, simply hover over it on any
equipment or inventory screen, then press [ST:icon p1=anarp ].

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_208_01_TITLE
rows.name: TP Gain Rating

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_208_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
TP Gain Rating indicates how readily TP accumulates
when fighting with an Inner Weapon equipped.
Check it if you want to accumulate TP more quickly.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_209_01_TITLE
rows.name: GP Gain Rating

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_209_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
GP Gain Rating indicates how readily GP accumulates
when fighting with a Doll's Hand Weapon equipped.
Check it if you want to accumulate GP more quickly.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_210_01_TITLE
rows.name: Objective Markers

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_210_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Signs indicating objectives for quests, Material Tracking,
and Squad Missions are displayed on the map and minimap.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_210_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
As long as an objective is registered in your navigation panel,
the markers will also be shown in the game field.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_210_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
Up to three markers may be shown for every objective.
If there are more than three objective locations, only the
three closest to your current position will be marked.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_211_01_TITLE
rows.name: Art Power

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_211_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Art Power is a value that broadly indicates how strong an
offensive Art is. If you want to prioritize dealing a lot of damage,
try filling your palette with Arts with a high Art Power rating.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_TITLE
rows.name: Inner Stats

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE01
rows.name: Total Melee Attack

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT01
rows.name: The higher the value, the more damage you deal with melee attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE02
rows.name: Melee Accuracy

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT02
rows.name: The higher the value, the more likely your melee attacks are to hit.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE03
rows.name: Melee Attack

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT03
rows.name: Contributes to total melee attack.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE04
rows.name: Total Ranged Attack

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT04
rows.name: The higher the value, the more damage you deal with ranged attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE05
rows.name: Ranged Accuracy

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT05
rows.name: The higher the value, the more likely your ranged attacks are to hit.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE06
rows.name: Ranged Attack

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT06
rows.name: Contributes to total ranged attack.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE07
rows.name: Max HP

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT07
rows.name: The maximum HP value, factoring in gear effects.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE08
rows.name: Max TP

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT08
rows.name: The maximum TP value, factoring in gear effects.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE09
rows.name: Defense

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT09
rows.name: The higher the value, the less damage you take.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE10
rows.name: Potential

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT10
rows.name: Higher values increase HP recovery and the power of Tension Arts.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE11
rows.name: Evasion

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT11
rows.name: The higher the value, the better the chance to evade incoming attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE12
rows.name: Physical Resistance

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT12
rows.name: The higher the value, the less damage taken from physical attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE13
rows.name: Beam Resistance

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT13
rows.name: The higher the value, the less damage taken from beam attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE14
rows.name: Ether Resistance

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT14
rows.name: The higher the value, the less damage taken from ether attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE15
rows.name: Heat Resistance

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT15
rows.name: The higher the value, the less damage taken from heat attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE16
rows.name: Bolt Resistance

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT16
rows.name: The higher the value, the less damage taken from bolt attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_SUBTITLE17
rows.name: Gravity Resistance

rows.label: TIPS_LST_001_CONTENT17
rows.name: The higher the value, the less damage taken from gravity attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_TITLE
rows.name: Types of Buff Effects

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE01
rows.name: Melee Accuracy Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT01
rows.name: Increases accuracy of melee attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE02
rows.name: Ranged Accuracy Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT02
rows.name: Increases accuracy of ranged attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE03
rows.name: Evasion Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT03
rows.name: Increases chance to evade attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE04
rows.name: Melee Attack Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT04
rows.name: Increases damage dealt with melee attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE05
rows.name: Ranged Attack Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT05
rows.name: Increases damage dealt with ranged attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE06
rows.name: Potential Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT06
rows.name: Increases HP recovery and damage dealt by Tension Arts, among other effects.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE07
rows.name: Physical Resistance Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT07
rows.name: Reduces damage taken from physical-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE08
rows.name: Beam Resistance Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT08
rows.name: Reduces damage taken from beam-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE09
rows.name: Ether Resistance Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT09
rows.name: Reduces damage taken from ether-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE10
rows.name: Heat Resistance Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT10
rows.name: Reduces damage taken from heat-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE11
rows.name: Bolt Resistance Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT11
rows.name: Reduces damage taken from bolt-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE12
rows.name: Gravity Resistance Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT12
rows.name: Reduces damage taken from gravity-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE13
rows.name: Damage Armor

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT13
rows.name: Puts up a barrier that absorbs a fixed amount of damage.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE14
rows.name: Bullet Charge

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT14
rows.name: Increases damage dealt by the next single hit of an Art attack.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE15
rows.name: Fake Body

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT15
rows.name: Guarantees evasion against a fixed number of attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE16
rows.name: Critical Power

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT16
rows.name: Increases the damage dealt by critical hits.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE17
rows.name: Effect Stasis

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT17
rows.name: Extends duration of buff effects by freezing their countdown timers.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE18
rows.name: Defending

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT18
rows.name: Greatly reduces the damage taken.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE19
rows.name: Aura

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT19
rows.name: Imparts the aura effect specific to the Art that created it.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE20
rows.name: Invincibility

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT20
rows.name: No damage is taken for the effect's duration.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE21
rows.name: Weather Immunity

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT21
rows.name: Prevents being affected by weather effects.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_SUBTITLE22
rows.name: Terrain Damage Immunity

rows.label: TIPS_LST_002_CONTENT22
rows.name: Terrain damage is not taken.

rows.name: Weather and Battle Probe Buffs

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE01
rows.name: All Attribute Resistance Up

rows.name: Raises all resistance stats, reducing damage taken.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE02
rows.name: Critical Chance Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_CONTENT02
rows.name: Increases critical chance.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE03
rows.name: Ether Attack Plus

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_CONTENT03
rows.name: Increases damage dealt with ether-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE04
rows.name: Heat Attack Plus

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_CONTENT04
rows.name: Increases damage dealt with heat-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE05
rows.name: Bolt Attack Plus

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_CONTENT05
rows.name: Increases damage dealt with bolt-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE06
rows.name: Gravity Attack Plus

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_CONTENT06
rows.name: Increases damage dealt with gravity-attribute attacks.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE07
rows.name: Resist Down

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_CONTENT07
rows.name: Lowers debuff resistance, making debuffs easier to inflict.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE08
rows.name: Doll Fuel Recovery

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_CONTENT08
rows.name: Continuously restores Doll fuel.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_SUBTITLE09
rows.name: Doll Fuel Recovery Up

rows.label: TIPS_LST_003_CONTENT09
rows.name: Increases fuel recovered while outside your Doll.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_004_TITLE
rows.name: Debuff Effects: Types of Reactions

rows.label: TIPS_LST_004_SUBTITLE01
rows.name: Break

rows.label: TIPS_LST_004_CONTENT01
rows.name:
Throws the target off balance, making them susceptible
to Topple or Catch.

rows.label: TIPS_LST_004_SUBTITLE02

rows.name:
You'll be given a [ST:col p1=red ]special allowance[ST:col p1=lightblue ] to carry out this mission.
Call it a war chest.
Fortunately, the Ma-non merchants have provided a [ST:col p1=red ]console[ST:col p1=lightblue ] aboard the New White Whale, too.
Use it to get your gear in order and prepare for the mission.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_164_01_TITLE
rows.name: Post-Game Save Data

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_164_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Loading Post-Game Save Data lets you resume the game
from the state you were in when you completed the Story Quest
"Chapter 12."

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_164_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
Your characters' growth, the state of your inventory, survey rate,
and other elements will be carried over.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_164_01_PAGE03
rows.name:
You can also accept the Story Quest "Chapter 13 (Act 1)"
again.

You can now register characters other than Al to be
the Ares's pilot.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_171_01_PAGE02

Furthermore, Al can now be registered to pilot

rows.name: Doll Quick Cooldown Unlocked

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_201_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Quick Cooldown can now be used with Dolls as well.
Doll Arts consume twice as much Aux Energy.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_044_01_TITLE
rows.name: Ares

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_044_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
My beloved [ST:col p1=red ]Ares[ST:col p1=lightblue ] is quite a handful, you know.
First off, its weapons are tailored specifically to it, so [ST:col p1=red ]it can't equip any other weapons.[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
And as you know, [ST:col p1=red ]I'm the only one who can pilot Ares.[ST:col p1=lightblue ]
It's a rather demanding machine, but master it and it'll be worth a hundred men. Well, good luck.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_081_01_TITLE
rows.name: Ares's Overclock

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_081_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Equipped with Overclock: LEGION.
Activates Accuracy & Evasion Up, Damage Dealt Up, Recast Up,
and Heal Parts.

rows.name: Charge Cloak

rows.label: TIPS_LST_021_CONTENT01
rows.name: Increases melee and ranged attack.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_AL
rows.name: Al's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_042_01_TITLE
rows.name: Hraesvelg Now on Sale!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_042_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
A new Doll, the [ST:col p1=red ]Hraesvelg[ST:col p1=lightblue ], is now available in the shop!
It seems to be a whole new design unlike any of the previous Dolls...
Hmmmm, my inner mechanic is getting excited...! We have to check it out!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_043_01_TITLE
rows.name: The Hraesvelg

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_043_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Looks like the [ST:col p1=red ]Hraesvelg has been released[ST:col p1=lightblue ] without a hitch.
Unlike previous Dolls, the Hraesvelg's [ST:col p1=red ]equipment cannot be swapped out[ST:col p1=lightblue ],
but it comes with [ST:col p1=red ]exclusive weapons[ST:col p1=lightblue ] unique to this model.
I'm sure you'll be able to master the Hraesvelg.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_084_01_TITLE
rows.name: Hraesvelg Cruise Mode Controls

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_084_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Press [ST:icon p1=b ] while jumping or flying to enter or exit Cruise Mode.
In Cruise Mode, tilt [ST:icon p1=anal ]↓ to ascend, [ST:icon p1=anal ]↑ to descend, and [ST:icon p1=anal ]←→ to turn.
Press [ST:icon p1=zl ] to slow down.

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_084_01_PAGE02
rows.name:
You can also press [ST:icon p1=a ] to perform a rolling dash, or press
[ST:icon p1=crsu ] to toggle cockpit view on and off.

rows.name: Hraesvelg's Overclock

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_155_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Equipped with Overclock: JINRAI.
Activates Accuracy & Evasion Up, Critical Chance Up,
and Recast Up.

rows.name: Ensures success of next Art's special effect.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_053_01_TITLE
rows.name: Hraesvelg's Cruise Mode

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_053_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Well? The Hraesvelg's flight was quite a sight, wasn't it?
[ST:col p1=red ]Cruise Mode[ST:col p1=lightblue ] lets it transform and [ST:col p1=red ]travel faster than conventional Dolls[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
The Hraesvelgs in circulation among BLADE have been upgraded as well,
so you should take one out and race through Mira's skies yourself.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_053_02_CONTENT
rows.name: Transform into Cruise Mode: [ST:icon p1=b ] while jumping/flying

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_RIESEL
rows.name: Liesel's Advice

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_045_01_TITLE
rows.name: New Gear Announcement: Mechanic

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_045_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
As a collaboration between Grenada GG and Arms,
[ST:col p1=red ]new gear for mechanics is now on sale[ST:col p1=lightblue ]!
I've been looking forward to its release for a while now... Ehehe.
Since we're here, why don't we take a look at the shop together?

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_046_01_TITLE
rows.name: New Gear Announcement: Ga Derg

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_046_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
To commemorate the alliance between humans and Larsians,
I hear [ST:col p1=red ]new gear has gone on sale[ST:col p1=lightblue ], modeled after
Ga Derg-san's and Ga Bow-san's outfits.
It looks like you can buy it in the shop now.

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_047_01_TITLE
rows.name: New Gear Announcement: Liesel

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_047_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
Oh, that's right!
With the release of the Hraesvelg, test pilot Liesel-san's pilot suit
has apparently been [ST:col p1=red ]added to the shop[ST:col p1=lightblue ] as well.
That helmet really has character... I think I rather like it!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_048_01_TITLE
rows.name: New Gear Announcement: Neil Nail

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_048_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
I hear [ST:col p1=red ]new gear modeled after Neil-san's outfit has gone on sale[ST:col p1=lightblue ].
Ah, of course, she's given her permission.
In fact, I hear she supervised everything, right down to the smallest detail...
Maybe I'll try it on too? Let's check the shop later!

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_049_01_TITLE
rows.name: New Gear Announcement: Al

rows.label: TIPS_ADV_049_01_CONTENT
rows.name:
To celebrate the return of our hero, Al-san,
[ST:col p1=red ]new gear modeled after Al-san's outfit has gone on sale[ST:col p1=lightblue ]!
Al-san really is loved by everyone, isn't he?
Why don't we buy some at the shop to celebrate, too?

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_212_01_TITLE
rows.name: Distress Beacons

rows.label: TIPS_BSC_212_01_PAGE01
rows.name:
Distress Beacons are signals sent out by allies scattered across the floating continent.
You can see them on the minimap.
When you spot a Distress Beacon, try searching the area around it.
